provenance.gamePatchAssumed: 8.7 content update on 2026-10-29, plus the 2026-11-05 bugfix patch. The 2026-11-19 balance preview is not applied.
provenance.damageFormula: Fribbels StatCalculator.getSkillValue at the same commit: ((atk * rate + hp/atk/def/spd scalings) * 1.871 * pow * (1+increasedValue) * hit) / (def * (1-pen) / 300 + 1). The extra dmgUpMod = 1 + selfSpdScaling * spd term in that function is not applied, because selfSpdScaling is already inside the flat scaling and would be counted twice.
provenance.element: Advantage multiplies damage by 1.1 (comment in Fribbels damageCalc.js). Disadvantage uses the miss hit type 0.75 and cannot crit or land the skill's debuff; the 50% glance chance is the long-standing attribute rule that selects that hit type.
provenance.resist: Debuff resist chance is max(15%, effect resistance - effectiveness), capped at 100%. Proc chance in the skill text is rolled first.

draft.notes: Prebans are secret and remove the hero for both sides. Each player's own third pick cannot be post-banned. Confirmed against the live Champion+ description on Hideout's RTA draft page (season 21 data through 27 Oct 2026) and the 8 Nov 2026 STOVE thread that still asks to remove the existing third-pick protection. The 5 Nov 2026 patch notes do not change draft rules.
